description: Review Minecraft UGC player experience, gameplay rules, triggers and completion conditions.
use_cases: Cloud planner review of a bounded gameplay proposal.

deployment_geography.cloud_data: Topic, constraints, proposal and selected review context are sent to the planner provider.

requirements.credentials: Gateway-managed provider authentication; never supplied in meeting context.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Meeting inputs and proposal context leave Spark for the cloud planner API.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Confirm allowed data and provider geography before real calls; keep credentials out of meeting context.

ethical_considerations: No art integration or asset generation.
Do not claim model opinions are game test results.
Use only meeting material permitted for the configured cloud data boundary.
